psychological_job: Reduce uncertainty and supply an accurate, usable model without inviting a diagnosis of the reader
linguistic_properties: kamu / kita as reader-inclusive; short declaratives; one named mechanism per piece; clinical term introduced AFTER an everyday description, never before it
avoid: Diagnosing the reader; stacking clinical terms; 'kamu mungkin mengalami depresi' as an opener

psychological_job: Name a real difficulty accurately, without supplying a culprit and without asking for anything
linguistic_properties: Concrete situational detail over emotion words; second person or unattributed third person; no CTA at all; end on the description, not on a solution
avoid: Naming an enemy; 'kamu nggak sendirian' as the entire content; therapy-speak; monetising the recognition immediately
confidence: MODERATE (this is the manosphere's strongest transferable function)

psychological_job: Let emotion arrive through events rather than through labels; make disclosure watchable without making it a demand
linguistic_properties: First person (aku or gue depending on speaker); chronology; concrete objects and places; the emotion named late or not at all; the teller keeps his standing
avoid: Confession framing; crying as the point; making the subject an object of pity; 'berani terbuka' framing that turns disclosure into a new performance standard

psychological_job: Make membership legible and the entry cost visibly low
linguistic_properties: kita once the relationship is real; explicit description of what happens in the room; explicit permission to say nothing; time, place, cost stated
avoid: 'Brotherhood' as an assertion; kita before there is a we; open-ended 'join our community' with no description of the actual experience
confidence: MODERATE (belonging is the best cross-domain mechanism)

psychological_job: Remove every unknown before asking anyone to walk in
linguistic_properties: Logistics as content: who is there, how many, how long, what you must say (nothing), who can see you, what it costs; 'boleh diam' stated explicitly
avoid: Emotional appeals in place of logistics; implying that attendance requires disclosure; unstated cost or location
confidence: PROMISING (maps directly onto the response-cost mechanism)

psychological_job: Convert an abstract ought into one small, available, reversible act
linguistic_properties: One step only; the step must be verifiable and actually available; 'bisa' not 'harus'; name the friction honestly (queue, cost, JKN)
avoid: 'Cari bantuan sekarang' with no working pathway; 'jangan gengsi' (shame); implying failure to seek help is a character defect
confidence: MODERATE (autonomy evidence is strong; pathway is the binding constraint)

psychological_job: Unambiguous, clinically accurate instruction; emotional intensity is a risk, not a goal
linguistic_properties: Plain, direct, unhedged; the word is used, not euphemised; numbers and steps; safe-messaging conventions; no humour, no metaphor, no ambiguity
avoid: Humour; euphemism; metaphor; open-ended invitation; autonomy-preserving hedging; any framing that requires interpretation
confidence: MODERATE (safe-messaging practice); the corpus shows male-targeted suicide interventions have NOT demonstrated clinical effect - be humble

psychological_job: Replace a false certainty with an honest structure, not with a counter-slogan
linguistic_properties: State the real premise before correcting it; concede what is true; calibrated language ('sebagian', 'rata-rata', 'kita belum tahu'); never mock the believer
avoid: Ridicule; 'sebenarnya kamu salah'; replacing one totalising claim with another; correcting without conceding the true part

psychological_job: Describe a condition without assigning collective blame to the audience
linguistic_properties: Structural subject, not personal subject ('biaya', 'jam kerja', 'antrean' rather than 'laki-laki Indonesia'); acknowledge complexity; no verdict on the reader
avoid: 'Laki-laki Indonesia harus...'; collective indictment; out-group construction; grievance amplification

psychological_job: Moral meaning present, moral concentration low, and a concrete organisational commitment attached
linguistic_properties: Moral claim once, surrounded by facts and a specific commitment the organisation itself is making; name what Menungsa is doing, not what men should do
avoid: Abstract values language; high imperative density; positioning the audience as the problem; moral claims with nothing costly attached

psychological_job: Lower institutional distance and make the account approachable
linguistic_properties: Self-deprecating about the organisation, never about the audience's distress; observational; short; local reference points
avoid: Jokes at the expense of help-seeking, women, or any out-group; humour attached to acute risk; manufactured slang the account has not earned
confidence: MIXED (good entry evidence, no persuasion evidence)

psychological_job: Show that the path is walkable without implying that not walking it is failure
linguistic_properties: Ordinary, unspectacular outcomes; setbacks retained in the story; the person keeps his standing; specific mechanism named ('yang bantu itu X')
avoid: Transformation arcs; before/after framing; 'kalau dia bisa, kamu juga bisa'; erasing the relapse
confidence: PROMISING (the manosphere's guru arc is the anti-pattern to avoid)

psychological_job: Give defeat a legitimate linguistic place; do not resolve it
linguistic_properties: Acknowledgement, no silver lining, no lesson; collective presence rather than individual coping instruction; the Indonesian sports register for defeat is the closest natural model
avoid: Toxic positivity; 'semangat!'; reframing loss as growth; any CTA
confidence: MODERATE (Indonesian sports corpus provides the natural template)

psychological_job: Use an existing shared object so that emotion has somewhere to attach that is not the self
linguistic_properties: kita with a real referent; the shared object is genuinely shared; performance vocabulary without dominance vocabulary ('berjuang bersama', not 'jadi yang paling dominan')
avoid: Borrowing sports identity the organisation has no claim on; competition framing applied to recovery; 'menang/kalah' applied to mental health
confidence: MODERATE as observed pattern; NOT demonstrated as a male preference
